asset.name: Sidebar
asset.description: The persistent navigation or workspace panel with sections, active state, collapse to icons, keyboard traversal, independent scrolling, and stable width.

requires.reason: Gesture behavior uses the governed gesture token foundation.
The resize seam uses the governed resize handle.
Sidebar styles are injected through the library stylesheet foundation.
Escape behavior is provided by the governed escape-key hook.
Reach-side behavior follows the governed handedness hook.
Panel size persistence and bounds use the governed resizable-panel hook.
Phone drawer gestures use the governed swipe-gesture hook.
